verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततस्तत्र तु राजानं तिष्ठन्तं भ्रातृभिः सह । उवाच देवकीपुत्रः सर्वदर्शी जनार्दनः ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said more Persons who perform acts consider the performance of acts highly. Likewise, those who are devoted to Knowledge do not regard anything other than Knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच । ब्राह्मणास्तात लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्चनीयाः सदा मम । एते भूमिचरा देवा वाग्विषाः सुप्रसादकाः । पुरा कृतयुगे राजंश्चार्वाको नाम राक्षसः । तपस्तेपे महाबाहो बदर्यां बहुवार्षिकम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Rare are persons fully conversant with the Vedas and depending upon the injunctions contained therein. The intelligent however consider the abstention from acts as the better of the two, viz., heaven and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: वरेण च्छन्द्यमानश्च ब्रह्मणा च पुनः पुनः । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो वरयामास भारत ॥३॥
verses.english: Endued with body, a person, through folly, and endued with anger and cupidity and all the propensities born of Darkness and Ignorance, cherishes attachment for all earthly objects.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजावमानादन्यत्र प्रादाद्वरमनुत्तमम् । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददौ तस्मै जगत्पतिः ॥४॥
verses.english: One, therefore, who wishes to destroy his connection with the body, should never perforin any impure act. On the other hand, one should create by his acts a path for attaining to Liberation, without wishing for regions of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: स तु लब्धवरः पापो देवानमितविक्रमः । राक्षसस्तापयामास तीव्रकर्मा महाबलः ॥५॥
verses.english: As gold, when united with iron, losses its purity and cannot shine, so Knowledge, when existing with attachment to earthly objects and such other shortcomings, fails to display its splendour.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाः समेताश्च ब्रह्माणामिदमब्रुवन् । वधाय रक्षसस्तस्य बलविप्रकृतास्तदा ॥६॥
verses.english: He who, influenced by cupidity, desire and anger, practises unrighteousness, transgressing the path of righteousness, is completely destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: तानुवाच ततो देवो विहितस्तत्र वै मया । यथाऽस्य भविता मृत्युरचिरेणेति भारत ॥७॥
verses.english: One who is desirous of benefiting oneself should never seek, with too much attachment, earthly possessions representing by the objects of the senses. If one does it, anger and joy and sorrow arise from one another.

verses.sanskrit: राजा दुर्योधनो नाम सखाऽस्य भविता नृषु । तस्य स्नेहावबद्धोऽसौ ब्राह्मणानवमंस्यते ॥८॥
verses.english: When every one's body is made up of the five original elements as also of the three qualities of Goodness. Darkness, and Ignorance, whom shall one worship and whom shall one censure with what words?

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैनं रुषिता विप्रा विप्रकारप्रधर्षिताः । धक्ष्यन्ति वाग्बलाः पापं ततो नाशं गमिष्यति ॥९॥
verses.english: Only the fools become attached to the objects of the senses. On account of folly they do not know that their bodies are only modifications of earth.

verses.sanskrit: स एष निहतः शेते ब्रह्मदण्डेन राक्षसः । चार्वाको नृपतिश्रेष्ठ मा शुचो भरतर्षभ ॥१०॥
verses.english: As a house made of earth is covered over with earth, so this body which is made of earth is saved from destruction by food which is only a change of earth.

verses.sanskrit: हतास्ते क्षत्रधर्मेण ज्ञातयस्तव पार्थिव । स्वर्गताश्च महात्मानो वीराः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः ॥११॥
verses.english: Honey, oil, milk, butter, meat, salt, treacle and grain of all kinds and fruit and roots are all modifications of earth and water.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वमातिष्ठ कार्याणि मा तेऽभूद् ग्लानिरच्युत । शत्रून् जहि प्रजा रक्ष द्विजांश्च परिपूजय ॥१२॥
verses.english: Giving up all desire (for rich food) herinits living in the forest take simple and unsavoury food, for only keeping up the body.
